sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Create an entry file and serve it over HTTP so relative paths and modules behave like production.

snippets.code:

# Format the file, then check it against the HTML5 rules
npx --yes prettier --write index.html
npx --yes html-validate index.html

sections.title: Forms
sections.description: A form posts named values to an endpoint, with every control tied to a label.

snippets.code:
<form action="/sessions" method="post">
  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input id="email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" required>

  <label for="password">Password</label>
  <input id="password" name="password" type="password"
         autocomplete="current-password" minlength="12" required>

  <button type="submit">Sign in</button>
</form>

<form action="/orders" method="post">
  <fieldset>
    <legend>Delivery method</legend>
    <label><input type="radio" name="delivery" value="standard" checked> Standard</label>
    <label><input type="radio" name="delivery" value="express"> Express</label>
  </fieldset>

  <label for="roast">Roast level</label>
  <select id="roast" name="roast">
    <option value="light">Light</option>
    <option value="medium" selected>Medium</option>
    <option value="dark">Dark</option>
  </select>

  <label for="notes">Order notes</label>
  <textarea id="notes" name="notes" rows="4" maxlength="300"
            placeholder="Grind for filter, 500 g bags"></textarea>

  <button type="submit">Place order</button>
</form>

<!-- File uploads need the multipart encoding -->
<form action="/uploads" method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data">
  <label for="receipt">Receipt image</label>
  <input id="receipt" name="receipt" type="file"
         accept="image/png,image/jpeg" capture="environment">
  <button type="submit">Upload</button>
</form>

sections.title: Meta and SEO
sections.description: The head carries the title, description, canonical URL, social previews and structured data.

snippets.code:
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Single origin beans | Northwind Coffee</title>
  <meta name="description"
        content="Washed and natural single origin coffees roasted weekly in São Paulo.">
  <link rel="canonical" href="https://northwind.example/beans">
  <meta name="robots" content="index, follow">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#2f4f3a">
</head>

<!-- Open Graph and Twitter tags control link previews -->
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:title" content="Single origin beans | Northwind Coffee">
<meta property="og:description" content="Roasted weekly in São Paulo and shipped within 48 hours.">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://northwind.example/social/beans-1200x630.jpg">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://northwind.example/beans">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">

<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
